summary.zh: 公开规则与模板支持 {zh, en} 双语字段与可选的 trigger / purpose / exclude；profile、compose 按项目语言选取文字，en 项目选用缺译文的公开规则时预览给出 untranslated 警告（不阻断）。
summary.en: Public rules and templates accept {zh, en} localized fields and optional trigger / purpose / exclude; profile and compose pick text by the project language, and an en project that selects a public rule without a translation gets an untranslated warning in the preview (not blocking).
